protocol.initialCondition: Fresh generated population for each seed, identical ideals and topology within seed before the first action. Tabular Q tables start at zero; neural weights use the same initialization protocol for each rule. No claim of learning convergence.

warnings: Best observed is conditional on this objective, population generator, reward, horizon, seeds and candidate set. It is not a proven optimum or a real-world prediction.
Sample SD describes between-seed variation; it is not a confidence interval. Near ties can reverse under new seeds or assumptions.
Tabular and neural Q learners are independent local learners in a nonstationary environment. No centralized planner, empirical human training or convergence guarantee.
Reward is not directly comparable across voting rules because ballot/conformity terms depend on rule semantics. Welfare uses the same true utility definition.
Least-served-community welfare is the minimum of nonempty community mean utilities in the evaluation window. Overlapping memberships count in each group; geography is not this objective.
